WHO WE ARE

Zus Health is an AI-native healthcare data platform that brings fragmented patient information together to make it complete, current, and actionable. Through our nationwide data network, platform, and intelligent workflows, we help providers, value-based care organizations, payers, life sciences, and digital health companies drive business results, strengthen provider trust, and improve operational efficiency. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus is building the foundation for a more connected, precise, and effective healthcare system.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR...

We are looking for an eager software engineering co-op to help build the next generation of healthtech tools. This co-op will be part of the Platform team.This team is responsible for the core transactional and analytical data stores that lie at the heart of all mission-critical data at Zus, the APIs for interacting with them, as well as the complex rules governing access control to patient data. The engineer joining this team will work on projects that improve the usability, scalability, and performance of the platform, which needs to handle high data throughput and volumes that are constantly growing. The ideal candidate will be someone who is curious about both high and low-level technical details of data stores and pipelines, enjoys mission-critical challenges and edge cases, and has a strong desire to ensure that patient data is secure and used appropriately.

 

You will work on APIs, data pipelines, and data stores that operate on large scale data using a variety of AWS services (DynamoDB, S3, EMR, etc) and Snowflake. You will work with many interconnected services that serve both internal and external users. We write most of our services in Go, but work with many tools and languages for specialized needs (e.g. TypeScript for UIs, Python for data engineering, Terraform for deployment, and many others).


AS PART OF OUR TEAM, YOU WILL...

 - Roll up your sleeves and build production-ready technology

 - Collaborate with your colleagues to build high quality solutions that scale


YOU ARE A GOOD FIT BECAUSE YOU DEMONSTRATE...

 - The ability to overcome challenging obstacles independently.

 - The self-awareness to recognize when outside assistance is needed.

 - The desire to learn about building software in a professional environment

 - The willingness to incorporate feedback into your work

 - The ability to write clean code

 - A love of solving complex problems

 - A self-starter attitude that shows that you are ready for the fast, and sometimes unstructured, nature of an early startup.

 - Located in the Boston, MA area and willing to join us in the office or regularly meet with a local mentor on a regular basis for collaborative work


IT WOULD BE AWESOME IF YOU WERE…

 - Interested in working with healthcare data and APIs

 - Able to work on a co-op from January through June


WE WILL OFFER YOU…

 - Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equity

 - Robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTO

 - Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)



Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.



We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.
fit_why: Full-stack/backend SWE co-op; Go and AWS gap, strong overlap

jd:
SPRING 2027 INTERNSHIP/CO-OP: SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Kirkland, WA · Full-time · Onsite




ABOUT SKYBAND

GPS jamming and spoofing affect thousands of flights every day (GPSThreatMap.com http://GPSThreatMap.com). Skyband Systems has built the M100, a certified avionics system to overcome this threat to safety and operational reliability. The M100 fuses satellite signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) with inertial sensing to give pilots a trusted position source that doesn't depend on GPS.

We're a VC-backed, fast-paced team based in Kirkland, WA, made up of engineers who built and scaled Starlink Aviation at SpaceX. We design, build, test, and fly our own hardware in our own aircraft. Everyone on the team has significant ownership over product areas or problem spaces.




THE ROLE

You'll be hands-on with the software team as the M100 goes from first production units through qualification, certification, and aircraft installation. You'll work directly with senior engineers who will give you real ownership and expect real results. By the end of your internship, you should expect that software you worked on will be test flown and used on commercial aircraft.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Write, test, and ship production software for the M100 and the systems used to develop, test, and operate it

 - Develop embedded and real-time software for sensor processing, system health, navigation, and aircraft interfaces

 - Build simulators, replay tools, and data-analysis software that turn lab and flight data into engineering decisions

 - Expand automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop testing, including fault injection and control of real hardware

 - Debug problems across software, Linux, networks, electronics, test equipment, and aircraft installations

 - Improve build, CI, release, and observability tooling so software changes are repeatable and traceable

 - Support system qualification and flight test, and document designs and results to the standard certification requires


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field

 - 3+ months of software engineering experience from internships, research, student project teams, or substantial personal projects

 - Comfortable writing and debugging software in at least one programming language; much of our work uses C++, Rust, and Python

 - Familiarity with source control, automated testing, and fundamental software engineering practices

 - Authorized to work in the United States


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - You’ve built and tested a meaningful software project outside the classroom and can explain the decisions and tradeoffs you made

 - Experience with modern C++, Rust and Python

 - Familiarity with Linux, embedded systems, concurrency, networking, or hardware interfaces

 - Experience with simulation, numerical methods, signal processing, estimation, or analysis of real-world sensor data

 - Experience building automated test systems, hardware-in-the-loop tests, or software that interacts with physical hardware

 - Familiarity with CI/CD, build systems, cloud infrastructure, telemetry, or production observability

 - Interest in aviation, navigation, GNSS, inertial sensing, or safety-critical systems

 - Clear written communication and the discipline to document assumptions, tests, results, and unresolved problems


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Full-time, onsite in Kirkland, WA for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning January 2027

 - Able to lift up to 25 lbs. and work in lab and hangar environments

 - Occasional travel for aircraft integration and flight test may be required


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $50.00/hour

 - $2500 relocation bonus

 - Paid holidays based on company holiday schedule

 - Direct mentorship from engineers who have shipped flight software at scale


EEO STATEMENT

Skyband Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer employment with Skyband is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
